Name: Content Patcher Dialogue Tutorial
Author: SquitzPrime
Description:
Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1521/]this dialogue template[/url]﻿

This is the 2 files needed to make a dialogue mod that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/url]﻿. 

This template uses the editData function of Content Patcher to add or change entries for dialogue. For more information see the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/ContentPatcher#readme]Content Patcher readme[/url]﻿

Recommended download to accompany this are:
[url=https://code.visualstudio.com/]Visual Studio Code[/url] to edit the .json files
[url=https://www.mediafire.com/file/b86xecd27yti6f6/XNBExtract0.2.2.zip]XNBExtract[/url] to see what the existing dialogue is for a character
[url=https://www.7-zip.org/]7zip[/url] for extracting the contents of the zip file

What this template includes:
[list=1]
[*]A content.json file with 212 entries for dialogue and 108 entries for marriage dialogue
[*]A manifest.json file that just needs your personal mod information
[/list]
Recommended reading for understanding how dialogue works:
[list]
[*]The Stardew Valley Wiki has an introduction to using dialogue commands [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Dialogue]here[/url]﻿.
[*]I created a more in depth [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/10oy2JQ69ofU5zeXNRfKPznrziSXYRmcXIaii9OqMOTw/edit]Guide to Dialogue using Content Patcher[/url]﻿, featuring examples and explanations. This is a work in progress, and I am still updating it. Feedback is appreciated, either by leaving a comment here or on Google Drive.
[*]Haywrites has a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Aj0M2pJifyJZfkVqKPjCq5IxFZbcw6U6bnbZPVDllTk/edit]Guide to Dialogue[/url]﻿ for using .xnb mods; which while the yaml specific syntax is not applicable anymore, the design philosophies are. 
[/list]
Once you are done adding dialogue to content.json, have filled out the manifest.json, and deleted all the comments from both files; simply put them in their own folder and put that folder in your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.

Downloads.Description: Content Patcher Dialogue Template for Stardew Valley. Version 1.2 or 1.3
